content:
Jornada 14 of the Liga MX Apertura 2026 is complete, and the weekend's biggest results came in Monterrey and Mexico City, where Chivas and Pachuca both won on the road against title contenders.

Guadalajara stunned Monterrey 1-0 at Estadio BBVA on Saturday, taking three crucial points in front of the Rayados home crowd. A day later, Pachuca beat América 2-1 in Mexico City, handing Las Águilas a home defeat in one of the round's marquee matchups.

Cruz Azul kept pace with a 3-1 win at Querétaro, while Tijuana closed the round with a 4-1 rout of Santos Laguna. Atlas edged Puebla 4-3 in the highest-scoring game of the weekend.

The round also featured three draws that hurt both sides in the playoff race. Pumas and Tigres settled for a 1-1 draw at Estadio Olímpico Universitario on Saturday, with Robert Morales opening the scoring in the 56th minute and Juan Brunetta equalizing in the 76th. The draw left Pumas in 12th place with 17 points and Tigres in 14th with 15 points, both outside the Liguilla qualification spots with three regular-season matches remaining. León and Toluca drew 1-1, and Necaxa and Juárez also finished 1-1.

Atlético San Luis completed the round's results with a 1-0 away win over Atlante on Friday. In all, Jornada 14 produced 27 goals across nine matches.

Sources: VAVEL; OneFootball.

title: Liga MX Jornada 14: Chivas Stun Monterrey, Pachuca Beat América, and Pumas-Tigres Draw Leaves Both Outside Playoff Spots
